none: PAS NLM-05D191: Roman Coin: Nummus of Constantine I
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy. Coin. Nummus of Constantine I (306-337), Sarmatia Devicta issue of 322-325, Reece period 16. Obverse description: Bust laureate right, possibly draped. Obverse inscription: CONSTANTINVS AVG. Reverse description: Victory advancing right trampling captive. Reverse inscription: [SARMATIA D]EVICTA. Cliff Reeves kindly identified this coin. Diameter: 18.9mm, Weight: 3.17gms, die axis: 6
